action.about: Something a user runs on an object: a menu row, a palette entry or a key. A surface places it by id.

block.about: A copyable block (code, a command, a log, a file excerpt): Copy, Send to terminal and Add to composer derive from it.

condition.about: A simulated real-life state (a slow link, a usage limit, a huge diff): one simulator induces it, a stage puts the app into it, one measure says whether it holds, and every surface its walks visit needs a case.

scaffold.entry:
export const {{name}} = define.condition({
	id: "{{id}}",
	group: "real-life",
	said: { date: "{{date}}", quote: "{{said}}", where: "{{where}}" },
	appliesTo: { walks: "all", categories: [] },
	simulator: "unbuilt",
	profile: {},
	measure: [],
	verdict: "reviewed",
	ci: { debt: "climb" },
	status: "parked",
});

lens.about: A holistic review angle (security, CI cost, test honesty, settings defaults): it groups conditions or names a check, and carries the reviewer's rubric. It has no pass/fail of its own.

setting.about: A setting: its page and anchor, its name and sentence for search, its stored key, and the surfaces it shapes.

surface.about: An object on screen with menus: right-click, its ⋯ and the palette list the actions it places. Rendered as <Surface id>.

fields.label: Open the incident it merged into

said.quote: Usage limit mid-turn: partial turn kept, the reset time, auto-resume once, a rail mark

measure.state: the partial turn kept, Limited with the reset time, one auto-resume, a rail mark

stage.live: the thread the limit-mid-turn alert opens, Limited with its reset time

said.quote: I want to do and build a comparable app, we first get a good enough app out and then worry about the small small security details

check.measure: open findings that are reachable without effort, do real harm and have a small fix

fields.rubric: Fix now only a finding that is reachable without effort, does real harm and has a small fix; every other one goes to the one security backlog issue.

fields.label: When you stop a turn
fields.sentence: Whether a turn's running sub-agents stop with it or finish.
fields.also: subagent sub-agent cancel interrupt stop cascade

fields.label: Sample menus
fields.sentence: Shows the gallery's sample object with its menus.

fields.label: At once in total
fields.sentence: How many agent-started threads may run at once.

fields.label: Messages per pair
fields.sentence: Messages between two threads in 24 hours before they stay unread.

fields.label: A day
fields.sentence: Thread starts and messages agents send in 24 hours.

fields.label: At once per starter
fields.sentence: How many threads one thread's agent may run at once.

8.title: Asks and approvals, including from another thread

10.title: Sub-agents, threads that start threads, and messages

12.title: Long threads on a patchy network

17.title: Usage and limits, including API-key failures

bare.title: The app with no condition applied

ci.title: The conditions that have a CI case

api.low-disk.title: The API told its disk is nearly full: statfs reports 20 MB and git worktree add fails
api.low-disk.run: PRISMALENS_CONDITIONS=low-disk on the API (--import api-preload.mjs), then node scripts/fakes/conditions/git-fixture.mjs git.worktree-disk --url <url>

clock.standby.title: The API's wall clock jumps past a wake while its timers did not run, as after a laptop sleeps
clock.standby.run: PRISMALENS_CONDITIONS=standby on the API (--import api-preload.mjs), then node scripts/fakes/conditions/standby.mjs --url <url>

fake.budget-cap.title: A scripted agent whose own $5 budget runs out mid-turn

fake.protocol-drift.title: A scripted agent a protocol version ahead, sending update kinds the host does not know

fake.runaway.title: A scripted agent repeating the same call ten times a second until stopped

fake.settle-cleanup.title: A thread holding a wake, a cron, a worktree and a running process, then settled

fake.usage-telemetry.title: A scripted agent that reports usage on every turn

git.fixture.title: A project thread's worktree put into a git state: a conflict, a force-push or a deleted branch

pw.time-zone.title: A browser in Asia/Kolkata with the en-IN locale

pw.two-devices.title: The same running thread on a desk and a 390 px phone; the phone steers mid-turn

fake.failure-case.title: A recorded provider failure played against a running PrismaLens

fake.message-loop.title: Two scripted threads that message each other in a loop
fake.message-loop.run: the fake ACP agent's message-loop session

net.throttle.title: A throttling proxy for any browser or the phone, which stamps what it saw

seed.huge-diff.title: A seeded thread that replays feat/w2-cp against main

seed.huge-output.title: Threads seeded with a huge log in a reply, a huge folded paste and a huge binary file

unbuilt.title: No simulator chosen yet: a parked entry from intake

quote-new-thread.title: Quote a selection into a new thread

answer-ask.title: Answer an ask from the dock

agent-starts-thread.title: Watch an agent start a thread that reports back by message
